projects.title: SOL Community Center
projects.seoTitle: SOL Community Center | Green & Gold Identity | DrawnOut
projects.seoDescription: Explore SOL Community Center's green-and-gold visual identity, from its circular symbol and typography to signage, apparel and community announcements.
projects.heroLine: A mark that carries a sense of connection.
projects.intro: A circular, nature-inspired emblem sits at the center of SOL Community Center's green-and-gold visual presentation. The symbol, serif lettering and warm cream accents repeat across community notices and branded applications.
projects.visualCopy: The identity is shown at different scales, from an exterior-sign mockup to apparel and printed pieces. The announcement layouts use the same color and graphic vocabulary while adapting to different messages.
projects.conclusion: A recognizable visual system built around a distinctive circular mark.
